title: Jonah and the Playlist
author: Paloma Oyelaran
blurb: Rafael Galloway, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does before graduation.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
